title: Nyxguard – Sci-Fantasy Female Armor Set (V03)
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202606/b7dc58039aa34aa7b750a433b8ad4ff5/images/2950881666d647619b2e0c1e69cbebe04bd3e862-b91d-4328-9806-0b5077d9a81aq.png)Recently finished this sci-fantasy female armor project, "Nyxguard".

My goal was to create a clean game-ready armor set that balances futuristic and fantasy elements while remaining optimized for real-time applications.

The asset features a low-poly workflow, quad-based topology, UV mapping, and 4K PBR textures.

I'd love to hear your thoughts on the armor design, proportions, materials, and overall presentation. Any feedback is greatly appreciated.![c380fb8716524b37ab602b002ab49f30](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202606/b7dc58039aa34aa7b750a433b8ad4ff5/images/c380fb8716524b37ab602b002ab49f303f92ca4e-e1a4-4761-abb6-831c7d123872.png)![b1e20792bed34f54a9d4c74eb2f92fff](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202606/b7dc58039aa34aa7b750a433b8ad4ff5/images/b1e20792bed34f54a9d4c74eb2f92fff111.png)![66e85e640613472aac2ca4e87bff5ad7](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202606/b7dc58039aa34aa7b750a433b8ad4ff5/images/66e85e640613472aac2ca4e87bff5ad7222.png)![5b6693d4c0de4ad8a69331969779fa09](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202606/b7dc58039aa34aa7b750a433b8ad4ff5/images/5b6693d4c0de4ad8a69331969779fa09Untitled-1.png)![3a05d9f189d74643a86aecdea923b3e3](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202606/b7dc58039aa34aa7b750a433b8ad4ff5/images/3a05d9f189d74643a86aecdea923b3e3Untitled-2.png)![5ca00c9c04334db0aaa89a9c73eb192e](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202606/b7dc58039aa34aa7b750a433b8ad4ff5/images/5ca00c9c04334db0aaa89a9c73eb192eUntitled-3.png)![b37325d835f14a6084322aeec45c3325](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202606/b7dc58039aa34aa7b750a433b8ad4ff5/images/b37325d835f14a6084322aeec45c3325Screenshot%202026-05-31%20183026.png)
